reply.text:
I'll check what you've been training and your shoulder situation before we talk about this. I don't see any logged sessions yet, so I can't tell if you're in the middle of something. But I can tell you the sign: a week off is for recovery from overuse that training rest can fix — things like a dull soreness that gets worse through the week, or volume that's piled up faster than your body can keep up.

If your shoulder has pain — sharp, catching, or pain that doesn't improve with a day or two off training — that's different and needs a doctor or physio first. Once they clear it, we can build a plan around whatever they want you to avoid.

Which is this: overuse fatigue, or something that hurts?
